ety.text: Inherited from Old East Slavic абие (abije, “now, suddenly”), from Old Church Slavonic абиѥ (abije, “now, immediately”), from Proto-Slavic *abьje. Compare also Old Novgorodian абьно (abĭno, “if, when”).
